import { Component } from '@angular/core'; @Component({ selector: 'app-about', templateUrl: './about.component.html', styleUrls: ['./about.component.css'] }) export class AboutComponent { }

About Our Marketplace

Welcome to our online marketplace! We connect sellers and buyers through a modern, user-friendly platform that enables easy product browsing, secure payments, and fast delivery.

Our Mission

To empower individuals and businesses by providing a seamless e-commerce experience that fosters trust, transparency, and innovation.

What We Offer

  • Wide range of products from multiple sellers
  • Secure online payment system
  • Responsive support team
  • Easy-to-use user and admin dashboards
